title: SigningRequest
description: The only message that may ask the Vault to sign. The Vault IPC wire format (ADR-004, implemented). The Vault independently re-validates capability, expiry, policy verdict, user authorization, lock state, and chain class — a well-formed request is necessary but not sufficient. v1.2: user_authorization is nullable — null is legal only on the daemon's confirm_and_sign message, where the Vault-side confirmation surface obtains the decision itself before signing (trusted-confirmation-surface.md requirement 3); sign_request still requires it present.

decision_id.description: policy decision this signing rests on; verdict must be allow, or escalate with satisfied escalation

decision.description: only approved authorizations may be embedded; rejections terminate earlier

surface.description: cli_prompt is a spoofable surface — labeled prototype limitation

escalation_acknowledged.description: required true when decision verdict was escalate
